description.value:
The shape resembles Paleolithic knives made from splintered bones. Perfect for both wood carving and... flaying. Crude, yet devilishly dangerous — the perfect weapon in the hands of a skilled combatant. A souvenir from Siberia.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month (Or try to take it from Kurt Hansen, your call)

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When this weapon deals damage to a target, until the end of the victim’s next Turn, all subsequent attacks from this weapon on that target deal 1d6 additional damage (4d6). Whenever this weapon causes the Broken Leg Critical Injury via an Aimed Shot, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 Total), the Broken Leg cannot be Quick Fixed, and the DV to perform a Treatment on it is increased by 2. This weapon is thrown using the Shortbow Range Table, can be thrown up to a maximum of 35m/yds, and continues to halve SP when thrown.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month (Or try to take it from Kurt Hansen, your call)
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
